result: One pill chip per file or batch state: Reading (info, percent when parts are known), Needs you (warning), Ready (success), Kept only (neutral), Stopped (danger). The Batches list Step cell shows the batch chip.
inputs: Captured buildings-original.geojson manifest row: docs/evidence/gf1/lq1a/controls-second.json; each test row sets only the facts that give its state, as the existing intake tests do.
decisions: itemChip order: stopped (not_understood with the server's stopped sentence) first, then needs you (itemPendingKinds), then reading (not isSettled), then ready (on_map, attached or a drafted package), else kept only.
Stopped uses the stopped facts without the sourceId condition, so a stopped file that cannot be retried still reads Stopped.
probe_failed and failed_part items with no pending answer are settled and not placed, so they read Kept only.
Percent is floor(partsDone / partsPlanned * 100), capped at 100; null when partsPlanned is null.
batchChip: waiting above 0 gives Needs you; Files or Reading gives Reading; Cards gives Ready; Your answers or Confirm with nothing waiting keeps the step text.
No CSS change: the badge fits the 112px Step column and is nowrap.
trayWiring: IntakeTray Status cell: replace `{stateWords(item.state)} · {placementWords(item.placement)}` with `<StatusChip chip={itemChip(item, items)} />`.
